context: A dad watches a sumo broadcast with his young son
purpose: Teach: 相撲/警視庁/市街地/パイロット/狼/ジェット/ギャグ/プロデュース

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ほら翔、大相撲始まったぞ。今日は警視庁の人も観に来てるらしい。
lines.en: Look Sho, the grand sumo's starting. Apparently someone from the Metropolitan Police HQ is watching too.
lines.style: Warm fatherly voice, slightly raised in excitement, casual living-room tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うわー、力士でかい!パパ、あの人、一匹狼みたいでカッコいい!
lines.en: Whoa, the wrestler is huge! Dad, that guy looks cool, like a lone wolf!
lines.style: High-pitched childlike excitement, bouncing energy, pure admiration.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ハハ、よく知ってるな。あの横綱、引退したら番組をプロデュースする話もあるんだぞ。
lines.en: Haha, you know your stuff. That yokozuna might even produce a TV show after retiring.
lines.style: Amused chuckle, gentle teaching tone, paternal pride.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: プロデュース?パパ、それなに?パイロットみたいなお仕事?
lines.en: Produce? Dad, what's that? Is it a job like being a pilot?
lines.style: Innocent curious questioning, head-tilt energy, slight confusion.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 違う違う、パイロットはジェット機を操縦する人だろ。プロデュースは番組を作る仕事だよ。
lines.en: No no, a pilot flies jet planes, right? Producing is making TV programs.
lines.style: Patient explanatory tone, gentle correction, warm laugh in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: へー!あ、見て見て、解説の人、ギャグ言ってるよ!全然面白くない!
lines.en: Wow! Oh look look, the commentator just told a joke! It's not funny at all!
lines.style: Sudden burst of excitement then deadpan critique, kid-honest delivery.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 確かに寒いギャグだなあ。あ、優勝パレード、市街地を回るんだって。
lines.en: Yeah that was a lame joke. Oh, the victory parade is going through the city streets.
lines.style: Comfortable agreement, then mildly impressed, leaning forward toward TV.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 見たい!パパ、連れてって!ジェットコースターより楽しそう!
lines.en: I wanna see it! Dad, take me! It looks more fun than a roller coaster!
lines.style: Pleading childlike enthusiasm, tugging-sleeve energy, pure begging.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: よし、出来れば来週行こうな。お母さんに聞いてみるよ。
lines.en: Alright, let's go next week if we can. I'll ask your mom.
lines.style: Soft promising tone, fatherly compromise, gentle warmth.
